study_goal: Find independent, source-verified, repeated marine survey-event network sampling around multiple islands before fish detection or future colonization responses are accessed.
source_owner: AODN / IMOS National Reef Monitoring Network (RLS, ATRC and partners)
preoutcome_checks: Official two dataset paths must exist and be readable via public anonymous S3 from frozen AODN bucket
Arrow _common_metadata schema must contain exact expected columns for survey and reef fish separately
Time partition fields timestamp and polygon verified; no species or abundance values read
Survey-date temporal coverage and island network support audited from survey metadata only after this source preflight
Survey population and fish records must join by source-provided survey_id; no assumption of complete absence without survey event method validation
RLS vs ATRC and other program methods cannot be pooled as independent networks without program and event unit grouping
RLS marine transect site proximity to coast is not an oceanic geological island class
next_condition: Only after exact schema/source attestation run frozen survey-event-only repeat-sampling denominator audit; fish biological values must remain inaccessible.
